tasks.label: tachyon: build-dev-host
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; PTR="${workspaceFolder}/.tachyon/dev-host"; if [ ! -e "$PTR/extension" ]; then echo "Tachyon Dev Host is not armed under this window:" >&2; echo "  missing: ${workspaceFolder}/.tachyon/dev-host/extension" >&2; echo "F5 always uses the monorepo window's .tachyon/dev-host (not a feature worktree)." >&2; echo "Arm from monorepo or any linked worktree (point auto-redirects to primary):" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point --worktree <feature-wt> --fixture <slug>" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point-status" >&2; exit 1; fi; EXT="$(cd "$PTR/extension" && pwd -P)"; test -d "$EXT/node_modules" || ln -sfn "${workspaceFolder}/node_modules" "$EXT/node_modules"; TACHYON_ENGINE_CHANNEL=dev npm run build --prefix "$EXT"
